desc:
Paint Me 🎨 Makeup Showdown is a freehand makeup game: paint your own look with a real brush on a 3D face, then vote for the cutest glow up!

Looking for a makeup game like Makeup Mania, Makeup Frenzy or Facecard Showdown ? This is a different game, not affiliated with them, with the same freehand idea: you do the makeup yourself.

💄 Lipstick, eyeshadow, blush, eyeliner, brows, lashes and glitter
🖌️ Blend by hand, with easy undo
📱 Made for your phone: pinch to zoom, one tap to jump to Eyes or Lips
⭐ Show your look every round and vote for your favorites
💾 Save your best looks

Into baddie, clean girl or goth makeup? Pick up the brush and make it yours.
